title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow, saying the company and shareholders plan to sell 825M Class A shares at $70 to $78 each, listing on the Nasdaq under ANT (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow, saying the company and shareholders plan to sell 825M Class A shares at $70 to $78 each, listing on the Nasdaq under ANT — Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
